params.name: searchTerm
params.description: Order name or tracking code associated with the shipment.

params.name: t
params.description: Base64-encoded customer verification payload. When provided, it can override `searchTerm` with its `query` value and should include the customer `email` or `phone`. Required only when customer search authentication is enabled for the shop.

items.docs: Search shipments for the authenticated shop by order name or tracking code. Requests require a Wonderment API access token with shipment read access. Some shops also require customer verification with the optional `t` query parameter.
